resolved.title: 管道 Channel
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Channels[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

As we saw in the previous lesson, Goroutines run independently and they do not know when another one has finished executing. This causes, for example, the [b]main[/b]() function to quit, before any started Goroutine has finished.

To enable communication between Goroutines, Go provides [b]Channels[/b].

A channel is like a [b]pipe[/b], allowing you to send and receive data from Goroutines, and enabling them to communicate and synchronize. 
[note]Similar to how water flows from one end to another in a pipe, data can be sent from one end and received by the other end using channels.[/note]

content.text:
正如在上一课中所看到的，Goroutine是独立运行的，它们不知道另一个Goroutine何时执行完毕。在某系情况下，将导致**main**()函数在任何已启动的Goroutine完成之前就退出了。

为了实现Goroutine之间的通信，Go提供了**Channel**(管道)。

**channel**就像一个**管道**，允许你在Goroutine中发送和接收数据，并使它们能够进行通信和同步。
content.text_html:
As we saw in the previous lesson, Goroutines run independently and they do not know when another one has finished executing. This causes, for example, the main() function to quit, before any started Goroutine has finished.

To enable communication between Goroutines, Go provides Channels.

A channel is like a pipe, allowing you to send and receive data from Goroutines, and enabling them to communicate and synchronize.

正如我们在上一课中所看到的，Goroutine是独立运行的，它们不知道另一个Goroutine何时执行完毕。例如，这将导致in()函数在任何已启动的Goroutine完成之前退出。

为了实现Goroutine之间的通信，Go提供了通道。

通道就像一个管道，允许你从Goroutine中发送和接收数据，并使它们能够进行通信和同步。

content.text: 类似于水在管道中从一端流向另一端，数据可以从一端发送，并由另一端使用管道channel接收。

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Channels[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To use a channel, we first need to make one using the [b]make[/b]() function:[code format="go" ]ch := make(chan int)  [/code]
The type after the [b]chan[/b] keyword indicates the type of the data we will send through the channel.

We can send data to the channel using the following syntax:[code format="go" ]ch <- 8 [/code]
Similarly, we can receive data from the channel using the following syntax:[code format="go" ]value := <- ch [/code]
If we do not need the value as a variable, we can simply use:[code format="go" ]<- ch[/code]
[note]Note: data flows in the direction of the arrow.[/note]

content.text:
我们定义了一个**bool**类型管道，并作为参数传递给`out()`函数。在该函数完成后，向该管道发送值**true**，该管道被**main**()接收。
现在，`main()`正在等待从通道中接收数据，使程序等待Goroutine完成执行。
content.text_html:
We define a bool channel and pass it to our out() function as an argument. After the function finishes its task, we send the value true to the channel, which is received in main(). Now, main() is waiting to receive data from the channel, making the program wait for the Goroutines to finish executing.

我们定义了一个bool通道，并把它作为一个参数传递给我们的out()函数。在该函数完成它的任务后，我们向该通道发送值true，该通道被main()接收。 现在，main()正在等待从通道中接收数据，使程序等待Goroutines完成执行。

content.text:
接收操作会阻止代码的执行，除非发送操作发送了一些数据。如果没有收到数据，就会发生**死锁**。

但代码中`<-ch` 只有一次，会看到其实只等待了其中一个Goruntine完成，所以输出并不是0-10。
content.text_html:
The receive operation blocks the code until and unless some data is sent by the send operation. If no data is received, a deadlock will occur, blocking the code from executing.

resolved.title: 管道 Channel

content.text:
让我们在Goruntine中向管道channel发送数据，并在**main**()接收数据。

假设程序需要计算并输出给定范围内所有偶数的总和加上它们的平方总和，并输出结果。

我们将使用两个Goroutine：一个用于计算偶数和，另一个用于计算平方和。
并在**main**()中获取管道数据，然后计算并输出最终的和。
content.text_html:
Let's use a channel to send data from a Goroutine and use it in main(). Our program needs to calculate and output the sum of all even numbers in a given range plus the sum of their squares and output the result: output = evenSum+squareSum

We will use two Goroutines: one to calculate the evenSum, and the other to calculate the squareSum. We will get the data using channels in main(), then calculate and output the final sum.

让我们用一个通道来发送来自Goroutine的数据，并在main()中使用它。 我们的程序需要计算并输出给定范围内所有偶数的总和加上它们的平方总和，并输出结果。 output = evenSum+squareSum

我们将使用两个Goroutines：一个用于计算偶数和，另一个用于计算平方和。 我们将在main()中使用通道获取数据，然后计算并输出最终的和。

content.text:
正如你所看到的，函数`evenSum`和`squareSum`将计算结果发送到管道中。
现在，我们在**main**()中用Goroutine调用两个函数，并输出结果的总和。
content.text_html:
As you can see, our functions send the result via channels. Now we can call them as Goroutines in main() and output the resulting sum:

正如你所看到的，我们的函数通过通道发送结果。 现在我们可以在main()中作为Goroutines调用它们，并输出结果的总和。

content.short_content:
evenCh := make(chan int)
sqCh := make(chan int)

// 开启两个goruntine
go evenSum(0, 100, evenCh)
go squareSum(0, 100, sqCh)

// 从管道中获取数据相加
fmt.Println(<-evenCh + <- sqCh)

content.text: 我们使用管道接收每个Goroutine的结果并输出它们的总和。
content.text_html:
We use the channels to get the result of each Goroutine and output their sum.

我们使用通道来获得每个Goroutine的结果并输出它们的总和。

content.text: 如果不再需要向一个管道发送数据，则可以使用**close(ch)**来关闭它，其中**ch**是管道的名称。通常在发送者中关闭管道。
content.text_html:
If you do not need to send data to a channel anymore, you can close it using close(ch), where ch is the name of the channel. This is done in the sender.

如果你不再需要向一个通道发送数据，你可以使用close(ch)来关闭它，其中ch是通道的名称。这是在发送器中完成的。

resolved.title: 并发计数器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定一个数字数组。输入一个数字，并输出该数字在数组中出现的次数。
为了使程序运行得更快，你决定将数组分成两半，并运行两个Goroutine。在每个Goroutine完成后，将每一半的结果相加，并输出最终结果。

给定的程序将一个数字作为输入，对数据数组的每一半调用**count**()函数作为两个Goroutine。

**任务：**
1. 定义**count**()函数，参数为一个数字、一个数组和一个管道作。然后，该函数应该计算给定数字在数组中出现的次数，并将结果发送到管道。
2. 收集2个Goroutine的结果并输出它们的总和。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Concurrent Counter[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given an array of numbers. You need to take a number as input and output the number of times that number occurs in the array.
To make your program run faster, you decide to split the array into 2 halves and run 2 Goroutines for each half. After each Goroutine is done, add together the results for each half and output the final result.

The given program takes a number as input and calls the [b]count[/b]() function as two Goroutines for each half of the data array.

[b]Task:[/b]
1. Define the [b]count[/b]() function, which should take a number, an array, and a channel as arguments. The function should then calculate the number of times the given number occurs in the array and send the result to the channel.

2. Collect the results of the 2 Goroutines and output their sum.

[note]Take a look at the Goroutines in the code to understand how the [b]count[/b]() function should work.[/note]
